ns2:section.sectionText: Join us for an interdisciplinary classroom working with an NGO on global sustainable community development in Jamaica! Develop your cultural intelligence skills and gain a global understanding while building invaluable cross-cultural communication and teamwork skills. The course concludes with a service trip to Jamaica between January 4-13 in January 2023.Enrollment in this section does not include travel costs, which must be paid separately. Estimated travel costs are $3330 and include round-trip airfare, ground transportation, lodging, meals, international insurance, and in-country programming. This section is restricted to students living in ISR’s Honor’s LLC. Scholarships are available.
